issues.description: Recipe attribute `url = ""` is empty. The merged a52dec precedent uses the identical bare empty url, so this is repo-consistent, but code-style rule 5 lists empty-url placeholders among unfinished-template markers and the value carries no explanation.
issues.fix_suggestion: Fill with the recipe repository URL (e.g. https://gitcode.com/OpenHarmonyPCDeveloper/build_in_harmonyos) as many merged recipes do, or add a short comment stating why it is intentionally left empty.

issues.description: Script opens with `set -u` only, not `set -euo pipefail` (code-style rule 7). This is a deliberate, necessary deviation for an assertion-counting harness: `set -e` would abort on intentionally failing probes (e.g. the exit-92 missing-device check and false predicates). Identical pattern in the merged bwm-ng test.sh. The deviation is implicit rather than documented in the file.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add a one-line comment near `set -u` stating why -e/-o pipefail are omitted (harness must survive expected failures; final exit is gated on FAIL>0).

issues.description: `grep NEEDED || true` carries no explanatory comment, while code-style rule 10 permits `|| true` only with a comment. Functionally no error is swallowed: grep exit 1 (no NEEDED entries found) is the success case here and the result is still gated by the following `-z` assertion. The merged bwm-ng test.sh uses the identical idiom without a comment.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add a comment such as: `# grep exits 1 when no NEEDED is found — that is the static-linked success case`.

issues.description: For the three consumer ELF checks (lines 59, 62, 65) the `command:` field says `readelf -h/-l smp_consumer_test`, but the actual verification mechanism is in-C parsing of /proc/self/exe inside test_consumer.c. The `description:` fields correctly say 自解析 /proc/self/exe, so this is documentation imprecision, not deception (the equivalent readelf checks do genuinely run in test.sh against the installed smp_rep_general binary).
issues.fix_suggestion: Align the `command:` fields with the real mechanism (e.g. `command: "C: parse /proc/self/exe ELF header"`) or annotate the readelf entries as equivalent-verification only.

issues.description: build() relaxes `umask 077` -> `umask 022` inside the pre-generated `configure` via replace_in_file. R6's letter says generated-file (configure) changes should go through generate() or patches/. The modification is build-time only (no generated file is committed), mirrors the merged bwm-ng precedent, and the zero-patch rationale is documented in notes.md — but the call sits in build() rather than generate().
issues.fix_suggestion: Optionally move the configure-umask replace_in_file into generate() — functionally equivalent, but matches R6's prescribed placement (the mpi_type.h swap is on a source file and is unaffected).

summary: Audited the 12 changed files (644 insertions) of branch feat/smp-utils-0.99. Worktree contents match the audit input byte-for-byte; the branch is a single commit (e8e7db7f9c) touching only archives/s/smp-utils/** — W2 atomicity OK, no forbidden files, no prebuilt binaries, no SUMMARY.md/ci/scripts/index.tsv trespassing, LF + final newlines on all files, JSON/YAML all parse, no TODO/FIXME placeholders. DECEPTION CHECKS (category 1) — all clean, independently re-verified against a freshly downloaded copy of the exact source tarball: (1) sha256 in conandata.yml and manifest.yaml matches the real Debian pool artifact (re-downloaded during this audit; hash a1cd2e7adc6bd1abefe32a4cd2b1163695324613078eee8f21a3b82fb4cc557f identical) — not fabricated; (2) license BSD-3-Clause confirmed from the shipped COPYING (Copyright 2006-2009 Douglas Gilbert, 3-clause text); (3) test_package is NOT an empty shell (R34): test_consumer.c calls five real libsmputils1 APIs whose asserted values match upstream lib/smp_lib.c exactly (smp_def_rrlen_arr: REPORT_GENERAL {0,6}, DISCOVER {2,0xc}; smp_get_num 2k->2048 / 2KB->2000 / 0x10->16; smp_get_llnum 1m->1048576; smp_get_page_size), plus genuine /proc/self/exe ELF64/EM_AARCH64/no-PT_INTERP parsing; test.sh discovers and executes every installed bin/smp_* binary (29 bin_PROGRAMS confirmed in src/Makefile.am), checks --version/--help output, verifies graceful missing-device failure exit 92 (SMP_LIB_FILE_ERROR == 92 confirmed in smp_lib.h:127) and readelf static checks (EXEC, no NEEDED); assertion math 13+38=51 is internally consistent across MANIFEST.yml/manifest.yaml/known run evidence; (4) status honestly 'built' (not 'published'), commands.json binary:false consistent — no fake status (R9/§3); (5) no __OHOS__ stubs, zero patch files, no skipped tests — upstream-no-tests claim verified (no TESTS= anywhere, no tests/ dir) and make check is still truly invoked in build() for the record per pitfall T009; (6) every OHOS-adaptation claim is corroborated in the source: bundled config.sub is 2018 (accepts aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, a52dec host-passing mode), `umask 077` exists at configure:13435 (E114), `typedef u_int32_t U32` at lib/mpi_type.h:53 (musl fix is real and minimal), public header installs to include/scsi/smp_lib.h (scsiinclude_HEADERS) matching package_info.includedirs, archive dir smp_utils-0.99 justifies strip_root=True; (7) no literal compile-command templates fabricated in docstrings; knowledge references E114/E007/T009 all exist (repo knowledge/ + pitfall-memo). R40: smp-utils is SAS hardware tooling, but there is no HAL surface to adapt — the tests exercise the platform-relevant behaviour achievable without SAS hardware (graceful no-device path, static/ELF identity, full library semantics); no stubs. RECIPE QUALITY — pass: R37 (0.99 first adaptation, no suffix needed), R32 (Linux/OHOS matched), R33 (no bare env vars, toolchain from AutotoolsToolchain), R39 (Debian pool = authoritative mirror; upstream site unreachable is documented; a52dec/plink/spaced precedent), R38 (software-level commands.json, type=tool, name matches), Conan 2.x API, and structural conventions (method order, package_type=library for a lib+tools package, requirements() pass, .la removal, validate armv8) all identical to the merged a52dec precedent. STYLE — pass with advisories. Five P3 suggestions (empty url, undocumented set -u deviation, uncommented || true, MANIFEST command-field imprecision, R6 placement of the configure umask replace_in_file) are all precedented in already-merged recipes and none affect correctness. FINAL: P0=0, P1=0, P2=0, P3=5 — verdict pass.
